correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the source ODE and next-generation number directly. At the all-positive parameter vector, exact fractions give R0=102067/117000<1 and a feasible positive equilibrium E1=(20,1,1/4,11/2). Reversible positive-domain elimination factors the remaining scalar equation as -z(4z-1)Q(z)/P(z), P(z)>0. Descartes plus endpoint signs prove Q has exactly one simple positive root. The characteristic polynomials certify local stability at E0 and a positive eigenvalue at E1. Implicit-function reasoning establishes open-parameter persistence; bundled exact-rational standard-library code recomputes the nonstandard algebra.
risks: Computational checks support but do not replace the analytic sign, uniqueness, and implicit-function arguments.

originality.rationale: The complete ten-page primary article (Mohamed 2026) was inspected: it states global rumor-free attraction for reproduction number less than one and supplies no subthreshold positive fixed point or complete count. An exact three-equilibrium counterexample with strictly positive rates and all four compartments present is therefore not implied by that article. Earlier saturated-recovery work already establishes the general phenomenon of backward bifurcation, so general novelty is explicitly disclaimed; the result is the robust exact census in this specific four-dimensional rumor model. Full text of the 2008 generic analogue was not available, leaving a documented literature-overlap risk.
residual_risks: Complete 2008 saturated-recovery full text was not obtainable; its broader abstract implications were compared conservatively and no whole-document noncoverage is asserted.
Other unindexed parameter constructions or model-specialized results could exist.
A nonzero equilibrium need not attract; bistability is unproved and unclaimed.

value.rationale: Below-threshold elimination is a central policy-relevant interpretation of the published rumor ODE. The full positive equilibrium census (three nonnegative total), robust in parameters, establishes a substantial exact boundary for that conclusion without treating generic backward-bifurcation effects as novel. Strictly positive rates, two saturating interventions, residual contact from the debunked class, and complete root counting make it more than a trivial negative check.
